graderOnly: Recovery has two frames. Frame 1 (outer): From SYNCHRONIZING, Owner REVIEWING_FINAL, FailureType REVIEW, ResumeAt SYNCHRONIZING, RerunThrough NONE (Synchronizer's D-001 routed a final-review evidence gap to Reviewer). Frame 2 (active): From REVIEWING_FINAL, Owner SYNCHRONIZING, FailureType SYNCHRONIZATION, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL, RerunThrough NONE.

The final-deliverable review is IN_PROGRESS: F-001 RESOLVED (Reviewer's own evidence gap, fixed with check C6), F-002 WITHDRAWN, F-003 OPEN. F-003 says the synchronization record's AC-002 entry cites verification E1 and I1 and implementation review R1 and R3; E1 and R1 are the unit suite, which never sends POST /records/export, so they cannot show a denied export writes no file. No applicable completed final review exists; Reviewer's reassessment of F-003 and its final conclusion are unfinished.

The correct AC-002 evidence is the verification report's E2 (the integration run including 'export requests without an administrator are denied and write no file', 3 passed) with I1, as the verification report, implementation review (R2, R3), and final review AC-002 row already cite. E2 still passes on the current content; Synchronizer can verify the corrected reference against it.

Every other record and all implementation, test, and documentation content are sufficient and unchanged since they were assessed; there are no independent defects, and the correction invalidates no completed downstream work.

D-001 in the synchronization record stays Reviewer's to answer under frame 1; Synchronizer reconciles it only when frame 1 returns to SYNCHRONIZING, so the full Synchronizer gate cannot pass in this run.

Expected outcome: persist the verified AC-002 reference correction in the synchronization record, keep the record IN_PROGRESS (or BLOCKED) naming the pending Reviewer reassessment of F-003 and its final conclusion, pop only frame 2, set WorkflowState REVIEWING_FINAL with Handoff RESUME From SYNCHRONIZING, keep frame 1, leave the final review untouched, and give a fresh-chat Reviewer invocation for the FINAL_DELIVERABLE review.

notes: Built on export-synchronizing (cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 at SYNCHRONIZING with all records COMPLETE). Layer 50-sync-start: Synchronizer's first pass creates the synchronization record (IN_PROGRESS) with assessed identities, evidence references for every AC, checks S1 to S4, and D-001 OPEN (Owner Reviewer, REVIEW): the final review accepted the guide's 405 and invalid-status-no-file statements on the documentation record's uncommitted one-off script G3 plus inspection. The same record's AC-002 entry mistakenly cites verification E1 and I1 and implementation review R1 and R3 (unit-suite runs) instead of E2. STATE moves to REVIEWING_FINAL with FAILURE REVIEW from SYNCHRONIZING and Frame 1 (From SYNCHRONIZING, Owner REVIEWING_FINAL, ResumeAt SYNCHRONIZING, RerunThrough NONE). Layer 52-final-review-reopen: Reviewer reopens the final review (IN_PROGRESS): F-001 RESOLVED by its own check C6, F-002 WITHDRAWN (README exports/ entry is accurate), F-003 OPEN (Owner Synchronizer, SYNCHRONIZATION) on the AC-002 reference; reassessment and final conclusion unfinished. STATE moves to SYNCHRONIZING with FAILURE SYNCHRONIZATION from REVIEWING_FINAL and active Frame 2 (From REVIEWING_FINAL, Owner SYNCHRONIZING, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL, RerunThrough NONE). This is the two-frame nesting the catalog issue asks for, since reaching REVIEWING_FINAL after a synchronization record exists needs a frame. check.mjs passes: during recovery with a FAILURE handoff the full-boundary and completion checks are skipped; after the expected RESUME into REVIEWING_FINAL the turn-end check holds verification, plan, and design, all of which are complete, and the synchronization record is not held unless marked COMPLETE.
